title: ScenarioKnobs
description: Observable context for one day at UREC. Produced by presets or text_to_knobs, consumed by the simulator and as forecaster features. Simulator internals (curves, zone quirks, noise, peak timing) are deliberately NOT knobs.

week_type.description: Label for UI and presets. The forecaster should use the numeric knobs, not this label.

students_on_campus.description: Share of the student body around campus (breaks are about 0.1 to 0.2).

academic_stress.description: Exam and workload pressure. Midterms about 0.6, finals about 1.0. Higher stress pushes visits later in the day.

novelty.description: New-semester or resolution energy. High in first_week and post_new_year, then decays.

weather.description: Harrisonburg weather that day. Rain pushes people indoors; snow keeps them home; hot fills the pools.

event_load.description: Intramurals, tournaments or club events in the evening. Mostly loads the courts.
